$comment: Voice-changer base assets (owned by P3-A; ids and the in-entry layout model.onnx are frozen in src-tauri/src/services/neural_audio/vc/assets.rs). Written by scripts/assets/vc_catalog.py; checks and contracts: scripts/vc-templates/export_pitch.py (reports/pitch.json).
vc/pitch-rmvpe: RVC's rmvpe.onnx (log-mel [1,128,T] -> salience [1,T,360]; rmvpe.rs computes the mel).

vc/pitch-fcpe: Sigil's adapter of the community FCPE export gzivdo/fcpe-onnx@5800a2b1 (torchfcpe 0.0.4 weights): audio [1,N] f32 16 kHz -> f0 [1, N//160+1] Hz, 0 = unvoiced (NaN from quiet frames mapped to 0). The contract fcpe.rs implements. Unpublished (Sigil-built).

vc/pitch-swiftf0: SwiftF0 model.onnx (audio [1,N], fmin, fmax scalars -> pitch f64 [1, N//256], confidence [1, N//256]; hop 256 = 16 ms, voiced when confidence >= 0.9). Also Applio's predictors/swift.onnx (identical bytes).
vc/pitch-crepe-tiny: onnxcrepe v1.1.0 tiny.onnx (frames [n,1024] zero-mean / unit-std windows, hop 160 -> probabilities [n,360]; cents = 1997.3794 + 20 * bin).
vc/pitch-pesto: import-only until a maintainer exports PESTO's streaming model with its own realtime/export_onnx.py (pesto@62bc0c97, mir-1k_g7.ckpt) as model.onnx; unpinned.
vc/voice-default: the MIT default voice PhoenixStormJr/RVC-V2-default-voice (v2, 40 kHz, f0, HiFi-GAN) with its feature index; P3-B imports default.pth into a slot on first run and adopts the .index.

entries.title: RMVPE pitch
entries.description: Accurate pitch tracking for the voice changer's GPU presets (RVC's RMVPE). About 360 MB.

entries.title: FCPE pitch
entries.description: Fast pitch tracking for the voice changer (FCPE). About 44 MB.

entries.title: SwiftF0 pitch
entries.description: Very light pitch tracking for CPU voice changing (SwiftF0). About 135 KB.

entries.title: CREPE tiny pitch
entries.description: Neural pitch tracking (CREPE, tiny model). About 2 MB.

entries.title: PESTO pitch
entries.description: Streaming pitch tracking (PESTO). Import a model.onnx exported with PESTO's realtime export script.

entries.title: Default voice
entries.description: A ready-to-use RVC voice (v2, 40 kHz) so the voice changer works before you add your own. About 118 MB.
